_scope: F27 host-owned production progression: earned type essence, the automatic XP trickle and paid Altar spending. Mode is immutable in each host event/receipt so pending/replay is not repriced. Actual Altar registration and typed journal/owner-save ACK remain required.
_scope_ordinary_release_payout_enabled: F27#1 release payout for the ordinary catch-overflow ceremony on the solo/host owner (scripts/net/essence_release_service.gd -> essence_release character action). Guests keep the legacy unpaid release until ordinary catches are host-typed.

_f47_0_clear_time_proposal.status: Owner choice. Not read by any runtime or ledger code; live values above are unchanged. Applying an option means copying its numbers into the live keys (auto_xp_scale, level_cost_bands[].multiplier, masters.json masters[].attuned_per_creature), then re-running node --test tests/test_f27_route_ledger.mjs tests/test_economy_*.mjs and an agent route measurement.

option_a_ledger_safe._why: Combat XP dominates leveling (level_cost multipliers up to 2.0 move break-even only a few points), so the trickle is the lever. At 0.28 the ledger's ordinary player (half the authored wild sites, no repeats) lands on every checkpoint with no margin; the existing F27 primary scenario still passes. Adds (0.50-0.39) x 1132 main-path wild sites = 125 fights.

option_b_reaches_target.ordinary_half_engagement_levels: tidewake 21/20, cloudreach 29/31, stormwood 39.2/42, finale-ready 52/54 (short; Altar spend from releases/candy or more authored fights closes it)
option_b_reaches_target.every_authored_body_once_ceiling: 30/20, 40/31, 50/42, 60/54: no repeat grinding is ever required
option_b_reaches_target._why: Adds (0.66-0.39) x 1132 = 306 first-time wild fights plus pricier Altar levels, so the normal pace engages about two-thirds of each chapter's authored wild sites. Needs an owner decision because tests/test_f27_route_ledger.mjs's primary ordinary scenario (0.5 engagement) would then fall short at Cloudreach/Stormwood and its assumption must move to 0.66.

_f47_0_clear_time_proposal.method: Estimated clear = agent estimate v2 (8.8-12.5 h, ralph/reports/EVIDENCE/F47-0/AGENT_ESTIMATE.md) + added fights x 1.0-1.5 min each (low: measured 8-21 s duels plus walking; high: the F27 ledger's MINUTES_PER_WILD_REFIGHT 1.5 incl. walking) + attuned gathering +0.5-1 h (PREPARATION_DEPTH_OPTIONS lever 2). Added fights = (new break-even - 0.39) x 1132, break-even found by stepping the engagement fraction 0.01 at a time in tools/f27_route_ledger.mjs runScenario with only these values overridden. Assumes the agent route already engaged about the old break-even share. Arithmetic only: the owner's play pass (F49#1) and a fresh agent route still decide F47#0.
